source.title: Discover additional small-capital permissionless caller rewards
source.body:
## Outcome required
Find at least 3 *documented, correctly deployed* alternatives to Kerf and Superfluid whose reward eligibility is public and funding requirement is under the user's $10 budget.

## Search dimensions
Mature low-fee L2/L3 networks, permissionless keeper incentives, expired market settlement, stream closure, vault harvest, liquidation caller compensation, order-filling bonuses. Do not rely on speculative token rewards, bounty exploits or unsafe unaudited contracts.

## Mandatory evidence for each
Current source + deployment, actual historical payout transaction, eligible public entrypoint, fees and token exit liquidity, real competition, and fresh net-economic example. Use `docs/EVALUATION.md` classifications.

**Success is evidence, not a promised 100× return.**

comments.author: ahmedelgaml70
comments.text: 2026-10-12 strict research filter after two underwhelming real-data tests: 1) Kerf RangeOrders had no orders created; 2) Superfluid Base has real payouts but small USDCx public-phase rewards and highly concentrated occasional ETHx outliers. **Before another bot**, require a successful recent *permissionless/third-party* receipt with native ETH or vetted stablecoin payment; estimate realistic sale price and transaction gas, determine whether caller is publicly eligible and record competing operator concentration. Spend $0 during screening. New speculative protocol source: Mar 16 2026 draft IExternallyExecutableBounty interface claims reference registry at 0x4B094F689e3edeDd04C439f1BeCDE8b4C800482B on Base/Arbitrum/ETH (https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/draft-erc-externally-executable-bounty-a-standard-interface-for-permissionless-task-automation/28002). It is ONLY an adoption hypothesis; no mainnet positive payout validated. Exclude until successful on-chain execution is observed.

comments.text: 2026-10-12 continuation: Repo updated with `docs/KEEPER_ALTERNATIVES_2026_10_12.md` and `pooltogether_claim_history.py` (read-only 6-hour current Base PrizePool `ClaimedPrize` reward + receipt audit). Important correction: reward denomination is deployed PrizePool.prizeToken(), not necessarily POOL governance token; current Claimer differs from deprecated claimer; code reads token selector and labels tx.to. Ripe Teller source public `liquidateUser` forwards msg.sender as keeper to a Teller-restricted AuctionHouse which mints GREEN if collateral- and debt-capped fee > 0. No successful recent payout from either independently verified yet, so no keeper deployment or wallet spending. Issues #4 and #5 track these verification gates.
